enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (2) vs.reply: DIFFERENT: they measure different analytes and specimens, with Record A assaying SARS-CoV-2 RBD-specific IgG/IgM/IgA in plasma and Record B assaying OC43/NL63 coronavirus RBD-specific antibodies in serum.

flow cytometry assay (2) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A measures ex vivo PBMC immunophenotypic lineage/marker-defined cell population frequencies, whereas Record B measures peptide-stimulated intracellular cytokine/granzyme responses (IFNγ, granzyme B, TNFα, IL-10) in CD8+ T cells.
